plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Baking and Pastry Arts, Associate of Applied Science' program page (Major Code: 4200A), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/business-and-information-systems-department/baking-and-pastry-arts/baking-and-pastry-arts-associate-of-applied-science . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the four semester tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals of 15 each). TRUE award: Associate of Applied Science (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 60'); semester tables sum 15+15+15+15 = 60. NOTE: the 2024-2025 plan differs from older catalog years - HOSP 266 'Food and Beverage Service*' (3 cr) + HOSP 266L 'Desert Cafe Lab*' (0 cr) sit in Fall Semester Freshman Year (not Spring), and SOCY 105 'Human Relations' (3 cr) sits in Spring Semester Freshman Year; this transcription follows the 2024-2025 page exactly. 0-credit corequisite lab: HOSP 266L 'Desert Cafe Lab*' (0 Credit) is flagged required_zero (excluded from credit sums by convention). Choice slots: MATH GE / ELEC GE / COMM GE are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice). PROG ELEC rows are 'Program Electives' (student choice, 3+3 = 6 hours total); the page lists a 6-hour program-elective menu (ARTS 105, BAKE 285 1-4 cr, BUSM 261, CHEM 100, HOSP 173, HOSP 174, HOSP 267, HOSP 267L 0 cr, HOSP 277 1 cr) - any combination totaling 6 hours. Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or Corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
